exact_source_record.exact_requirement: Source coverage and reusable omission detection. Auto-populate inputs from authorized sources with citations and confidence, then disposition every inherited/new input, persona, surface, field, integration, output and gate as Applicable, N/A with rationale, Deferred with dependency/date, or Unknown with an owner. A percentage is never a substitute for resolving critical omissions.

exact_source_record.exact_requirement: Execution completeness and evidence scoped approval. Record the requested mode and existing authority once, complete all authorized unblocked outputs, and ask consolidated questions only for unresolved decisions. For long tasks maintain a deliverable manifest and resumable progress; do not label unfinished output complete. Test the declared implementation level: design review, synthetic prototype, connected pilot or production. A passed render/build proves only that check. Prompt approval, architectural approval, production release, commercial availability and public publication are distinct decisions.
